messages.missingType: A context-menu command's `@Declare` must set `type: ApplicationCommandType.User` or `.Message`.
messages.hasDescription: A context-menu command's `@Declare` must not include a `description`.

cases.code:
import { ContextMenuCommand, Command, Declare, ApplicationCommandType } from 'seyfert';
@Declare({ type: ApplicationCommandType.Message, name: 'm' }) class M extends ContextMenuCommand {}

import { ContextMenuCommand, Command, Declare, ApplicationCommandType } from 'seyfert';
@Declare({ type: ApplicationCommandType.User, name: 'm' }) class M extends ContextMenuCommand {}

import { ContextMenuCommand, Command, Declare, ApplicationCommandType } from 'seyfert';
@Declare({ name: 'c', description: 'd' }) class C extends Command {}

import { ContextMenuCommand, Command, Declare, ApplicationCommandType } from 'seyfert';
@Declare({ type: ApplicationCommandType.Message, name: 'm', description: 'd' }) class M extends ContextMenuCommand {}

import { ContextMenuCommand, Command, Declare, ApplicationCommandType } from 'seyfert';
@Declare({ name: 'm', description: 'd' }) class M extends ContextMenuCommand {}
